scope: Purposively selected recent publications, including older-priority grants. Selected clauses and finite models are checked; patent validity, novelty, complete claim coverage and empirical performance are not assessed.

cases.locator: Description of electroadhesive clutches and their control, including FIGS. 2A and 2B
cases.supports: Controlled electrode attraction couples apparel surfaces; friction and clutch arrangement turn attraction into adjustable holding.
cases.finding: Existing electrostatic attraction supports the force clause. A complete clutch additionally needs contact, friction, geometry and control; no new fundamental electroadhesion entry is needed.

cases.locator: Abstract and device description: heat collection fins, infrared radiator and temperature-rise suppression
cases.supports: A conductive collection structure feeds an infrared radiator while shielding limits unwanted heat inflow.
cases.finding: Conduction and thermal radiation already exist. Their coupled temperatures, spectra and heat balances prevent treating the two unary clauses as a serial chain or asserting below-ambient cooling.

cases.locator: Description of magnetic material, magnetocaloric element filling unit and fluid flow paths
cases.supports: Magnetocaloric material changes thermal state when its applied magnetic field changes, with fluid paths providing heat exchange.
cases.finding: The magnetic-to-thermal response was missing. Curie switching is a different selected clause and cannot simply be inverted. Heat exchange, regeneration and operating cycle remain separate.

cases.locator: Background definition of adiabatic electrocaloric temperature variation and multilayer element description
cases.supports: The multilayer polymer element uses a field-dependent caloric response; layer construction is a particular implementation.
cases.finding: Add the field-to-temperature clause under a shared caloric family. Polymer composition is a specialization requiring material evidence, not another independently predefined effect.

cases.locator: Background electrocaloric response and ceramic-layer element description
cases.supports: A ceramic-layer device uses electrocaloric response with material and fabrication constraints distinct from a polymer stack.
cases.finding: Reuse the same response interface for this material case while leaving its quantitative calibration and operating envelope unproved. Recent grant publication does not imply recent scientific discovery.

cases.locator: Claims and description of the first piezoelectric actuator deforming the wafer and the unactuated valve
cases.supports: Piezoelectric actuation deforms a pump chamber and a valve arrangement controls flow and power-loss closure.
cases.finding: The direct stress-to-voltage clause did not supply converse actuation. Add a separately sourced voltage-to-deformation clause; wafer/fluid coupling and power-loss closure remain unverified.

cases.locator: Description of the electroosmotic pumping mechanism and fluid-actuated delivery arrangement
cases.supports: Electroosmotic pumping moves working fluid within a larger mechanical delivery system.
cases.finding: Liquid electroosmosis was missing. Gas-phase ionic wind does not substitute for its interfacial liquid response. Pressure loading, electrode reactions and delivery mechanics require additional models.

cases.locator: Description of resistive memories, programmed weights and extraction/compression crossbar layers
cases.supports: Stored resistance values encode weights within a multi-input analog processing network.
cases.finding: Ohmic readout is only a conditional subclause at fixed conductance. Programming history, multi-input accumulation and training remain a model gap. A temporary synthetic stateful example tests that distinction; no memristor primitive is installed.

cases.locator: Description of similarity-based activation and deactivation of speculative decoding
cases.supports: A controller selects drafting and verification behavior according to a similarity criterion.
cases.finding: This is a controlled algorithmic construction. Finite exact sampling can test a selected gate and correction rule, while arbitrary probabilistic equivalence, controller policy and actual inference speed remain outside the unweighted categorical checker. No new primitive effect is installed.
